import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter to expression and clinical features
    expr_clin_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) 
                     if typ in ('expression', 'clinical')]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6)
    correlated_pairs = [
        ('XBI15', 'YCB3'), ('MHCW4', 'WCUT6'), ('EECP17B', 'HHQZ11L'),
        ('SCCA3', 'HHQZ11L'), ('IGT11', 'VNZ3B'), ('EECP17B', 'SCCA3'),
        ('LMYS16L', 'CRDU10L'), ('FGR16', 'WCUT6'), ('SHF4', 'YCB3'),
        ('HHQZ11L', 'IGT11'), ('MHCW4', 'HHQZ11L'), ('XBI15', 'SHF4'),
        ('EECP17B', 'IGT11'), ('PKD8B', 'HHQZ11L'), ('IZQ3', 'LMYS16L'),
        ('SCCA3', 'IGT11'), ('SLRD9', 'HHQZ11L'), ('IZQ3', 'CRDU10L'),
        ('PZUU9', 'HHQZ11L'), ('MHCW4', 'FGR16')
    ]
    
    # Keep one feature from each highly correlated pair
    keep_ids = set(expr_clin_ids)
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        if a in keep_ids and b in keep_ids:
            # Prefer the one with higher t-statistic
            ta = feats.x[:, feats.column(a)]
            tb = feats.x[:, feats.column(b)]
            t_a = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(a)], 
                                    feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(a)])[0])
            t_b = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(b)], 
                                    feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(b)])[0])
            if t_a > t_b:
                keep_ids.remove(b)
            else:
                keep_ids.remove(a)
    
    # Get remaining features
    remaining_ids = list(keep_ids)
    
    # If no features remain, return empty design
    if not remaining_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute correlation matrix
    x = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in remaining_ids]]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    
    # Cluster features based on correlation
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=1, linkage='average')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Select the cluster with highest mean effect size
    best_cluster_idx = np.argmax([np.mean([abs(stats.ttest_ind(
        x[feats.y==1, i], x[feats.y==0, i])[0]) for i in range(len(remaining_ids)) 
        if clusters[i] == c]) for c in set(clusters)])
    
    # Get features in the best cluster
    cluster_features = [remaining_ids[i] for i in range(len(remaining_ids)) 
                       if clusters[i] == best_cluster_idx]
    
    # Check if any features have strong effect
    if not cluster_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Create a weighted score using all features in the cluster
    loadings = {}
    for fid in cluster_features:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx], 
                                   feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])[0])
        loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    # Normalize loadings
    total_weight = sum(loadings.values())
    if total_weight > 0:
        for fid in loadings:
            loadings[fid] /= total_weight
    
    # Return design with at most MAX_DRIVERS drivers
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(cluster_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
        columns=tuple(cluster_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
